in_marathi.name: Maurya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Maurya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Maurya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Maur', which means 'ruler' or 'king'. In Hindu mythology, Maurya is a name associated with powerful and wise rulers, such as the Maurya Empire founded by Chandragupta Maurya in the 4th century BC.
